# HeyAgent

> Local Telegram bridge for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok CLI agents. Voice notes, session pickers, provider switching — no server required.

## Repository

- GitHub: https://github.com/appfabriek/heyagent
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/heyagent
- CLI command: `hey`

## What it does

HeyAgent connects Telegram to AI coding agents on your Mac:

- Send prompts from your phone or CarPlay via Telegram
- Get agent responses in the same chat
- Switch between Claude Code, Codex, and Grok with `/claude`, `/codex`, `/grok`
- Pick projects and sessions with `/projects` and `/sessions`
- Transcribe voice notes locally with Whisper (ffmpeg + whisper-cli)
- Hands-free session picker: `go to project myapp` → reply `2`
- Run as a background service (macOS launchd)

Fully local. Config at ~/.heyagent/config.json. No hosted backend.

## Install

npm install -g heyagent
hey grok    # or: hey claude / hey codex

## Documentation

- README.md — full user guide: setup, commands, voice notes, CarPlay, background service
- AGENTS.md — architecture and contribution guide for AI coding agents

## Prerequisites

- Node.js 18+
- claude / codex / grok CLI on PATH (whichever providers you use)
- ffmpeg + whisper-cli for voice transcription (optional)
- cloudflared for phone onboarding QR flow (optional)

## Key source files

- bin/hey.js — CLI entry
- src/bridge.js — Telegram polling and message routing
- src/voice-transcriber.js — local Whisper transcription
- src/voice-session-picker.js — numbered voice session picker
- src/sessions.js — local session discovery
- src/providers/ — claude, codex, grok execution
